articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced its financial results for the Second Quarter of 2025. The Company will host a conference call on August 15, 2025, at 10:00 AM ET to discuss results.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), announced today that it will release its Second Quarter 2025 results on Thursday, August 14, 2025, after the stock market closes. Senior management will host a live webcast and conference call to review on August 15, 2025, at 10:00 a.m. ET.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Date for Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Conference Call
